# scamp_database (Resource)

Manages a managed database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Valkey, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs or Qdrant on its own server, run, backed up and updated by ServersCamp. The database has its own name under the database domain with a certificate we renew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_database" "app" {
  name        = "app-db"
  engine      = "postgresql"
  plan        = "db-bs-s"
  backup_days = 7
}

output "database_url" {
  value     = "postgresql://${scamp_database.app.user}:${scamp_database.app.password}@${scamp_database.app.host}:${scamp_database.app.port}/${scamp_database.app.default_database}"
  sensitive = true
}
```

`terraform apply` returns once the database runs, usually in a few minutes. Plans are named by engine:
`db-` PostgreSQL, `my-` MySQL, `os-` OpenSearch, `ch-` ClickHouse, then `bs` (Basic) or `hf` (High Frequency)
and the size, e.g. `db-hf-m`. A wrong name fails with the list of plans of the engine.

## Changes in place

- `plan`: another plan of the same engine and line. The server restarts.
- `disk_gb`: grows online. It never shrinks; the disk also grows by itself when it fills up.
- `public`, `require_tls`, `durability`, `backup`, `backup_days`.

Changing `name`, `engine`, `version`, `network_id` or `security_group_id` replaces the database, with its data.

## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) postgresql, mysql, valkey, opensearch, clickhouse, victoriametrics, victorialogs or qdrant. Changing it replaces the database.
- `name` (String) Name of the database server: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. It is the start of its address. Changing it replaces the database.
- `plan` (String) Plan, e.g. db-bs-s. Changed in place to another plan of the same engine and line (Basic or High Frequency); the server restarts.

### Optional

- `backup` (Boolean) Point-in-time backups into our S3, for engines that have them. Default true. Changed in place; turned off, the stored backups are deleted.
- `backup_days` (Number) Days of point-in-time restore: 3, 7, 14 or 30. Default 3. Changed in place.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk size in GB. Without it the disk that comes with the plan. Grows in place, online; it never shrinks.
- `durability` (String) Write mode: standard, fast or extreme (no backups in extreme). Default standard. Changed in place.
- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network, attached to a router. Without it the account's default network. Changing it replaces the database.
- `public` (Boolean) Ports on the router's public address. Default false. Who may connect is the security group's to say. Changed in place.
- `require_tls` (Boolean) Every network connection over TLS. Default false. Changed in place.
- `security_group_id` (String) UUID of a security group. Without it a new group is made with the engine's ports open and everything from the private network and VPN Gateway. Changing it replaces the database.
- `version` (String) Engine version, e.g. 18 for PostgreSQL. Without it the engine's default. Changing it replaces the database.

### Read-Only

- `default_database` (String) The database made with the server, where the engine has one.
- `host` (String) The database's name, for connections from the private network and over VPN Gateway.
- `id` (String) The database's id.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The owner user's password.
- `pool_port` (Number) Port of the connection pooler (PgBouncer, transaction mode), where the engine has one.
- `port` (Number) The engine's port.
- `private_ip` (String) The server's address in its network.
- `public_host` (String) Public address, empty when public is off.
- `public_port` (Number) Public port of the engine, empty when public is off.
- `state` (String) creating, configuring, running, updating or failed.
- `user` (String) The owner user.

## Import

```shell
terraform import scamp_database.app 4e5b1e18-9802-4d1a-962b-d03a32f5b5d5
```
